values.note: Pratt County: service sites 1-21 (water and electricity) $20 a night whether or not the services are used; primitive camping in designated areas and on fishing piers 2-21 $5 a night (no overnight camping on pier 1). A camping permit is required. Set by Resolution 3-6-2023, still the county's posted rule on 2026-11-06.

fees.source: https://www.prattcounty.org/DocumentCenter/View/688/Pratt-Count-Lake-Resolution-362023 (item 19: 'Overnight camping, whether by tent, vehicle (e.g., RV/camper), or otherwise requires obtaining a permit and payment of the following fees: (a) Primitive camping (in designated areas) $5.00/night (b) Piers 2-21 $5.00/night* (c) Service Sites 1-21 $20.00/night**'; '**Service Sites 1-21 have access to certain services (e.g., water and electricity). The $20.00/night fee applies regardless of whether services are actually used.'), adopted 2023-03-06, linked from https://www.prattcounty.org/134/Lake-Regulations, read 2026-11-06

values.note: Up to 14 consecutive days, then a 48-hour absence of people, equipment and vehicles before camping again. Holding a pier or service site with an unattended vehicle is prohibited.

booking.source: Pratt County Resolution 3-6-2023 (item 8: 'Camping or remaining at the Lake for a period longer than fourteen (14) consecutive days is prohibited. A forty-eight (48) hour absence of persons, equipment, and vehicles is required between each camping period of fourteen (14) consecutive days.'; item 18), read 2026-11-06; replaces the derived 7-night maximum from note prose

hookups.source: Pratt County Resolution 3-6-2023 (item 19: 'Service Sites 1-21 have access to certain services (e.g., water and electricity)'), read 2026-11-06

sites.source: Pratt County Resolution 3-6-2023 (item 19: 'Service Sites 1-21'), read 2026-11-06; replaces the derived 12 from note prose (primitive and pier sites not counted)

note: Pratt County's lake park: gravel pull-through service sites on open ground west of the lake road, plus primitive camping in designated areas and overnight camping on fishing piers 2-21 (not pier 1); fire rings, dump nearby. Swimming and wading are prohibited, and motorboats are allowed only for no-wake fishing. --Claude
summary: County resolution (2023-03-06, still posted): service sites 1-21 $20/night (water+electric), primitive/piers $5, 14-day max (stored 7 was wrong) with 48 h absence; count 12 -> 21. Lake far over 5 acres; lakeview confirmed. Pin ~175 m south of the sites.
flags: Rate date: the $20 comes from the county's Resolution 3-6-2023 (adopted March 2023), which is still the rule the county posts on its Lake Regulations page (read 2026-11-06) - earlier than the 2024 date line, so AWH may want it treated as undated. No newer county page or resolution was found. fees.checked set to '2023'.

Phone: none found. The county lake page and the resolution give no lake or superintendent phone (the resolution names a 'Lake Superintendent'). Google Maps 'Pratt County Lake': 4.3 (112 reviews), no phone or website listed. The county courthouse number is not posted on these pages, so nothing to add.

Waterfront (stored lakeview): CONFIRMED. The lake is a dredged reservoir with piers, roughly 500 x 400 m on imagery (tens of acres, far over the ~5-acre pond line). The service sites are gravel pull-throughs on open grass ~60-90 m west of the water, with the campground's own road and the lake's west-shore road between: open ground with the water visible = lakeview, and the roads block anything higher.

Waterfront lead: the county also sells overnight camping ON fishing piers 2-21 ($5, primitive, no services). The piers are gravel spits into the lake; whether a motorhome may park on one isn't stated. Not a basis for lakefront on the service-site entry.
Pin: stored 37.62962,-98.68509 is at the park entrance by the road ~175 m south of the service sites; the pull-throughs centre on about 37.6312,-98.6849 (imagery, pads visible). Suggest moving there.

Hookups: electric 50 (derived from note prose) left as stored: the county says only 'water and electricity', no amperage. facilities.flush_toilets (derived) left: not stated by the county. booking reservable false / fcfs always (derived) left: the resolution requires a permit but doesn't say how one is obtained.
